responsibility: Implements package import lookup and import-data reading for the Go frontend, including search-path handling, filename suffix probing, object/archive export-data discovery, stream abstractions over files and strings, and parsing support for imported inline function bodies. It is the main entry point for locating imported packages on disk and for turning serialized export data back into frontend package, type, declaration, and function-body structures.
same_name_distinction: Implements the import subsystem declared in `import.h`: filesystem/package lookup, suffix probing, export-data discovery inside files, stream reading, and reconstruction of imported inline function bodies. Unlike `import.h`, it contains the executable logic for locating and decoding imports rather than just the importer and stream interfaces.
